"""P11: round-1 claims on the deepest valid index windows (PPI-D351 -17.1%, PPI-C241 -5.0%) plus forecast;
hold 300 ppm / no chargeback; same ladder shape as the agent."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import hold_policy

CASE = "case:P11"
R1 = ("Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.\n\n"
      "Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 "
      "(idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02).\n"
      "Producer prices DE: casting of metals changed -5.0% from 2024-09 to 2025-09 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-09, idx:PPI-C241@2025-09).\n"
      "Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).\n\n"
      "We propose EUR {p:.2f} per unit with a 300 ppm commitment.\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
LATER = ("Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you for moving. We can go to EUR {p:.2f} per unit with the 300 ppm commitment and "
         "place the order this week.\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
move = hold_policy(CASE, 38.5, {"ppm_commitment": 300, "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": 0}, R1, LATER, share=0.3)

case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Part case:P11 - our proposal
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, the index change data you cite does not concern this part or our company. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. We can do the 300 ppm you want, but it takes more work on our end, so the best we can do is EUR 46.50. Also, we need you to pay faster if we're going to hit these tight quality targets. 

Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
